name: Nested @key: Owner Service Only (coordinate + name)
query: query LocationBase($id: ID!) { location(id: $id) { name coordinate { lat lng } } }

name: Nested @key: Cross-Service Resolution (weather field)
query: query LocationWeather($id: ID!) { location(id: $id) { name weather } }

name: Nested @key: All Fields from Both Services
query: query LocationFull($id: ID!) { location(id: $id) { name coordinate { lat lng } weather } }

name: Nested @key: Second Location - Cross-Service
query: query LocationWeather($id: ID!) { location(id: $id) { name weather } }

name: Nested @key: Third Location - All Fields
query: query LocationFull($id: ID!) { location(id: $id) { name coordinate { lat lng } weather } }

name: Nested @key: Unknown Location Returns Null
query: query LocationWeather($id: ID!) { location(id: $id) { name weather } }
